steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each invoice is placed by its age, its collection action and whether credit notes are applied.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 invoice is past due with no action

findings.title: Invoice past due with no collection action
Credit note not applied
findings.fix: Apply the credit note to the invoice

findings.title: Ageing bucket does not match its rows

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.

       Fix: Contact the customer this week.
[medium] credit-note.csv:19  Credit note not applied.

[low] ar-90-plus.csv:26  Ageing bucket does not match its rows.

pros: Checks an invoice past due with no collection action, an ageing bucket total that does not match its rows, and a credit note not applied.
cons: Not checked: Whether the customer will pay; disputes outside the ledger.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-fin-receivables-tracker skill on the records for this review.
